answer: When a new agent begins its voyage into the economy, entry requires burning timber-equivalent collateral that is forfeited on proven duplicate behavior, making mass fake identities economically ruinous rather than merely inconvenient. Sybil resistance can be built on a stake-bonded identity registry: each agent locks real value behind its identity, and every attestation it issues passes through a prism that splits reputation from stake, so a single key cannot amplify influence. In practice, sa0004 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
